query: How should microsimulation parameters be calibrated and validated (administrative benchmarks, backcasting, out-of-sample checks) and which behavioural responses (labor supply, household formation) must we test in sensitivity analyses?

response.query: How should microsimulation parameters be calibrated and validated (administrative benchmarks, backcasting, out-of-sample checks) and which behavioural responses (labor supply, household formation) must we test in sensitivity analyses?
response.answer: Microsimulation parameters should be calibrated using administrative benchmarks and validated through backcasting and out-of-sample checks. Sensitivity analyses must test labor supply and household formation responses.
